input.summary: Extend the Base Components licence to Customer Affiliates and contractors, remove at-will revocability, and permit transfer to a successor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, replaced "revocable" with revocation only for our uncured material breach, and confirmed transfer to a successor consistent with § 14.10. Our playbook does not accept a licence that IBM can revoke at will or that excludes the affiliates and contractors who actually use the Services; if helpful, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to IBM.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement, revocable only in the event of Customer's material breach that remains uncured following notice and the applicable cure period, and transferable to a successor to Customer's business by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
